children: Overview
Denmark shipping firm's Q3 net profit rose to $54 mln from $26 mln last year
Company raised full-year net profit guidance to $200-250 mln
Company announced $15 mln share buyback and interim dividend for Q3
Outlook
NORDEN raises full-year net profit guidance to $200-250 mln from $180-230 mln
Company says guidance increase reflects strong Q3 and solid expectations for Q4
NORDEN notes geopolitical uncertainty and voyage timing could affect earnings timing
Result Drivers
MARKET CONDITIONS - Co said strong markets and solid operating performance across Dry cargo and Tankers supported Q3 results
FLEET MANAGEMENT - Co said active fleet management and additions to core fleet in Handysize and MPP segments contributed to performance
CHARTER CONTRACTS - Co said securing long-term charter contracts for MR tankers and Capesize vessels helped lock in future revenue and reduce volatility
